entries.title: Automatic keeps what it read about your other computers when your project's host is slow
entries.body: When the place your project lives was slow to answer one of your other computers, Automatic threw away everything that computer had said about itself, and a ready task waited with every check of it marked unknown. Now that computer answers in time with what it read, so the waiting task names only the project-access check that could not finish.
entries.noPicture: The waiting task's message keeps its look; for the other computer it now lists one reason instead of five.
